"Kazama★"
There he was, sitting in his own seat as if nothing had happened.
What on earth was going on?
When had he come into the room?
In that one tiny instant when I opened the door...?
Had everyone else seen him do it?
"{b}?
The host can't be spacing out like that.
Everyone's busy, and they've gone out of their way to make time to be here, you know."
...How selfish could one person be?
Who was the one who wasted everyone's precious time?
I couldn't believe someone this flaky had a sixth sense.
Who knew how much of that story earlier was even true...
Forget it.
Getting too involved with this guy just wore me out.
The best thing to do with someone like this was ignore him.
I sat down in my seat and said, in as calm a voice as I could manage:
"Well then, shall we move on to the next story?"{p}
